I can pay up to 290000 US cents for it, and not a penny more than that. Do you carry business laptops in the color magnetite? Send me no more than 3 messages; I turn away every one past that. You have 43 steps to finish this job. Among the matches, the lowest price takes it. My wife handles the seed orders from the kitchen table, so the machine will move around quite a bit from field season to winter. Any business laptop in the color magnetite will serve me well, and I will put it to work the day it arrives.
